      "script": "#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec 2>&1
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('/var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-baseline.conf').read_text()
old = 'filter azure_export {\n  if net ~ [10.110.0.0/24, 10.120.0.0/24, 10.130.0.0/24, 10.140.0.0/24] &&\n     (proto = "own_dc" || proto ~ "mesh_*") then accept;\n  reject;\n}'

assert base.count('export filter azure_export;') == 2, 'Both peers must share the filter'

Path('/var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-candidate.conf').write_text(base.replace(old, 'filter azure_export {\n  if net ~ [10.110.0.0/24, 10.120.0.0/24, 10.130.0.0/24, 10.140.0.0/24] &&\n     (proto = "own_dc" || proto ~ "mesh_*") then {\n    bgp_path.prepend(65013);\n    bgp_path.prepend(65013);\n    accept;\n  }\n  reject;\n}'))

birdc configure

echo SOURCE_BEGIN

sha256sum /etc/bird/bird.conf /var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-baseline.conf
birdc show protocols
echo EXPORT_BEGIN
birdc show route export azure_0 all
echo EXPORT_END
echo SOURCE_END
"

bird -p -c /var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-candidate.conf
